reason: PURE is the only one I would even look at, because the Complex has citrate and that is what gives me cramps. The first thing I noticed was the sachets, which are handy for flying, but $29.99 for a month with zero reviews is a lot when I can buy a bottle of glycinate for half that and fill my pill case myself.
objection: A dollar a day for a brand nobody has reviewed, when I already count capsules into my own pill case for free. The sachet is a nice idea but I am paying extra for packaging.
would_change_my_mind: A price around $18 to $20 for the 30 box, or a few hundred honest reviews saying it does not upset the stomach.
